description: Changes how one of this business's flows starts ("Starts when" in Automations) and whether it is on, exactly as the Automations editor's save does. starts_when "contact" means "You add it to a contact": nothing starts the flow by itself. Any other value starts it automatically on that booking event. Switching a start off ("contact") or turning a flow off (active false; its runs in progress end) is open to this seat. Starting a flow on an event or turning a flow on is owner-level: available only when the owner turned on "Let this agent change owner settings" for this seat; the owner is told about each such change. A flow that starts on every upcoming job (starts_when_words says so) turns on only after a person confirms how many jobs it covers, which this tool cannot do: it comes back refused with that count, and the owner turns it on in Automations. Picking a booking event here makes a flow start only on jobs from then on. read("flows") shows each flow and its current start. Events: booking_created (New job booked); booking_changed (Job changed); booking_cancelled (Job cancelled); staff_clocked_in (Cleaner clocked in); staff_not_clocked_in (Cleaner hasn't clocked in); job_finished (Job finished); visit_unconfirmed (Past job not marked done in the booking platform); card_declined (Card declined); review_received (Review received); review_low_rating (Low-star Google review); staff_on_the_way (Cleaner tapped On the way); staff_clocked_out (Cleaner clocked out); staff_running_late (Cleaner says they are running late); staff_not_on_the_way (Cleaner hasn't tapped On the way); staff_not_clocked_out (Cleaner hasn't clocked out); staff_clocked_in_twice (Cleaner clocked in on two jobs at once); staff_schedule_request (Cleaner asked to change their schedule). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the original result.

active.description: true turns the flow on, false turns it off.

first_booking_only.description: With an event: true starts it only on a client's first booking. Omitted keeps the current choice.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

justification.description: Optional: why the business wants this. Shown to the owner with an owner-level change.

starts_when.description: "contact" for by hand only, or the booking event that starts it.

name: set_flow_start
title: Change how a flow starts
